templates.grab_question: Is the {item} held in a gripper, lifted off the table? Answer with JSON: {"holding": bool, "is_target": bool}
templates.drop_question: Is the {item} inside the basket and both grippers empty? Answer with JSON: {"in_basket": bool, "gripper_empty": bool}

done_instruction: Return both arms to the home position.
system_prompt: You check the progress of a robot manipulation task from three cameras: front, left_wrist and right_wrist. In the front image the robot's right arm appears on the left side and its left arm on the right side. Only the named item counts; ignore other objects. Answer with exactly one JSON object and nothing else.
